verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents mapping controls to CMMC requirements to identify gaps and readiness status. It also documents per-framework control mapping with automated control testing, continuous compliance-status monitoring, and a view of failing tests. Together these cover the core idea of tracking readiness against a framework, but nothing shows a single readiness percentage or an explicit passing/gap/remaining breakdown for every framework. missing for 10: a documented per-framework readiness percentage, an explicit breakdown of passing vs. open vs. remaining controls across all frameworks (readiness status is only evidenced for CMMC), independent or hands-on corroboration of the readiness view's accuracy.
